rules: Exceptional state extends a persistent entity; it does not bypass identity/history contracts.
Transformation must declare whether base species/body, memories, legal identity, visual identity and relationships persist, transform or split.
Copying appearance never copies memory, authority or relationships automatically.
Assimilation is state transition, not a species reroll.
Symbiotic joining may create a composite lived identity only according to setting-specific rules; prior identities/history remain traceable.
Exceptional capabilities are scoped and never imply omniscience.
AI cannot create exceptional powers or transformations without authoritative event/state.
